1. The model is correct and the system is not near tipping despite some early warning-like trends
2. The model is not reliable because the query is out-of-distribution (distance to pool is notable)

The context has 14 near tipping and 149 far from tipping - mostly far. The model might be biased toward "far" predictions because of the context composition.
